title: Keep text layout physical and zoom independent
description: Ensure text wrapping and placement depend only on the physical content region and bundled font metrics, while preview zoom is applied after layout and cannot alter scene geometry.
acceptanceCriteria: Text wrapping uses physical content width and height in millimetres plus deterministic bundled font metrics
Browser viewport dimensions are absent from the pure layout input
Changing preview zoom does not change line breaks, text runs, element bounds, diagnostics, or assignments
Resizing the browser does not change the serialized printable scene
Zoom remains a bounded session presentation value rather than durable project state

steps.details: Review the layout contract and remove viewport pixels, SVG dimensions, device pixel ratio, DOM measurements, and zoom from scene-generation inputs.
Implement zoom as an SVG/CSS presentation transform or viewport-size choice around immutable scene primitives, with bounded controls and a reset action.
Store zoom only in session UI state and exclude it from project records, templates, assignments, snapshots, autosave payloads, and scene hashes.
Generate a canonical scene before and after multiple zoom values and viewport sizes, then assert deep equality of wrapping, bounds, runs, diagnostics, and assignment metadata.
Change zoom and browser size through public controls, assert visible scale changes, and verify line breaks and geometry-backed attributes remain unchanged.

technicalNotes: CSS pixel scaling is not physical layout input.
Avoid browser text measurement because it can vary with installed fonts and rendering engines.
